name: Spending alert (AWS Budget)
summary: A monthly cost budget in your own AWS account that emails you at 80% of actual spend, at forecast overrun, and at 100%. Costs nothing and watches everything.

parameters.name: notify_email
parameters.description: Where alerts go. Ask the user for this; it cannot be guessed.

notes: Alerts, does not block. Account-wide rather than filtered to resources this system created, because tag-filtered budgets need cost allocation tags activated manually and take up to 24 hours to apply.
